title: 安静双脚
description: 彩铅表现两只脚稳稳踏点的开始姿态，清楚展示脚点与软垫。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: Create an original colored-pencil scene of a fictional adult in an opaque blue T-shirt and loose climbing trousers settling both feet on generous low footholds. The nearly vertical wall carries a friendly line of mint-green jugs, spaced so the next handhold is comfortably reachable without a leap. Frame the figure from slightly below shoulder height while keeping the feet, low wall base, and uninterrupted padded landing visible. One hand rests on a jug and the other gently tests the next hold. Emphasize textured pencil marks, calm concentration, realistic limb proportions, and a bright uncluttered gym. Include no text, brands, or dangerous height.
